job.name: ig17_host_2
job.meaning: Спокойная женщина ~40, тёмные волнистые волосы, бордовое платье, у окна на закате, золотой свет на лице — «тёплая, как подруга, которая знает»
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of a calm, warm Russian woman about 40 with long dark wavy hair, a deep burgundy knit dress, a thin gold chain. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, medium close shot from the chest up, face large and sharp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge, looking straight into the lens, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, calm, warm, knowing expression, NO broad smile. Look: a real frame from a phone camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark. Background: by a big window at sunset, golden light falling on her face, a softly blurred city behind the glass.
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary person (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
